name: io.github.zai-one/telegram-mcp
title: Telegram MCP
description: Your Telegram account for AI assistants: inbox, search, safe sending, polling; toolsets, read-only mode and per-chat ACL.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_SECRET_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Private env file with TELEGRAM_API_ID, TELEGRAM_API_HASH, TELEGRAM_SESSION_STRING

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_CHATS
environmentVariables.description: Comma list of chat ids/@usernames; set = deny all others

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_DENIED_CHATS
environmentVariables.description: Comma list of chat ids/@usernames always denied
